personal.name: Darshan Prabhakar
personal.summary: I’m a recent engineering graduate who’s already had a taste of the real world through Java backend apprenticeships and fellowships. Skilled in Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and MySQL, but versatile enough to jump into React when needed. I love creating solutions that aren’t just functional they’re fun, useful, and a little bit clever. Curiosity keeps me learning, and cheekiness keeps me sane.

projects.title: TalentBridge Campus Recruitment Platform

Developed scalable REST APIs and dashboards using Spring Data JPA to streamline campus hiring workflows.
